trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the set and this one pops on its own. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 — it unlocks as the story moves forward.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Reach the end of Chapter 1 and it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 and it unlocks when the chapter ends. The asterisks are part of the official name.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 and it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 and it unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission in Chapter 5. Free roam stays open after the credits, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. It needs 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, all 39 illegal operations, all 8 bank vaults, and Bret's 15 target decks.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist needs 300. Find stunt spots on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, and watch progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the two ranges — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some stay locked until you meet their conditions. Track them under Activities, Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; a few charge an entry fee. Track them under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race never counts twice. Most race spots let you hire a car, and a car's Rating matters, so upgrade it at a Mod Shop. Track under Activities, Racing.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in Chapter 1 he texts you a fishing spot. Catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg; you need a boat with a rod, and hijacking one works.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. Lucia only; it opens with a phone call in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand — seven shipwrecks. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later, so it is not missable. The final mission is Maritime Disputes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2; the final mission is Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and which ones is still being confirmed — it can be done after the story, and it is not part of 100% completion.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand by finding his wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down the labs in Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots; a meditation only counts once the final zen animation plays. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find them on the map under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida. Possibly missable: one Chapter 1 morning meditation at Jason's house — Lucia meditates on the balcony, so follow her and accept the optional quest — is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx flags it; Push Square lists no missables, and it is unclear whether the trophy needs that one spot, since it is not marked like the other 18. Do it when it comes up.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only, from Chapter 2. Which animal triggers it is unconfirmed — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% needs anyway, should cover it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets; 100% needs 15. Cards sold at Pawn Shops still count toward progress. Track under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app — hold Up to open it: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Track under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; 100% needs 70. Track under Progress, Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along and escape. Possible once both characters can roam together, from Chapter 2; bank jobs hand out 4 stars anyway.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner without losing the wanted level. It pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough — you do not have to drive them. 100% needs 200 of 277. Track under Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet parked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They have been found at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. There are eight vaults in total and 100% needs all eight; bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. Grade note: Push Square lists this as Bronze, but the starter list, Insider Gaming and sixshore all list Silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or blow a truck's back door open with a sticky bomb earlier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is fastest.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in total and 100% needs all of them.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. Do not trust a walkthrough that claims otherwise; check PowerPyx for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. Check PowerPyx for updates.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress. Note: Push Square does not mark this one as hidden.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline, but that is a suspicion, not a confirmed step.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle, but neither is confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences and contacts. It adds up across robberies; the dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages, about $160,000 in total. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
